Selected schema shows recorded direct grants, nested roles, PUBLIC and PUBLIC-role paths. For each role, one shortest representative path is shown from the user and from PUBLIC. All ACLs shows the raw entries visible to the login. Grant mapping requires DBA_HOST_ACES and DBA_ROLE_PRIVS access; missing coverage is reported. A granted role or DEFAULT_ROLE=YES does not prove that the role is enabled during execution. This is not an effective-access calculation covering role activation, PL/SQL context, host/port precedence, ACE order, validity or inversion. No matching rows does not mean a blocked connection. OCI NSGs, security lists and target IP allowlists must be checked separately. Refresh invalidates raw ACL and per-schema path caches together. The SQL below is a read-only example.
